passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: You should read the following discussion and analysis of the Group’s financial condition and results of operations in conjunction with the Group’s consolidated financial statements and the related notes included elsewhere in this annual report. This discussion may contain forward-looking statements based upon current expectations that involve risks and uncertainties. The Group’s actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of various factors, including those set forth under “Item 3. Key Information—D. Risk Factors” or in other parts of this annual report. -120- Table of Contents A. Operating Results Overview We are a leading Chinese Smart EV and NEV company that designs, develops, manufactures and markets Smart EVs and NEVs that primarily appeal to the large and growing base of middle-class consumers in China. We are also expanding our international presence, with a focus on the mid- to high-end segment in the global passenger vehicle market. Since inception, we have taken an innovative technology path to our envisioned future of mobility. We intend to empower consumers with our differentiated Smart EVs and NEVs that can offer disruptive mobility experiences. We believe this can be achieved by fast iteration of software and seamless integration with hardware, which enable us to lead the innovation of Smart EV and NEV technologies and provide differentiated Smart EV and NEV products to consumers. Since our inception in 2015, we have become one of the leading Smart EV and NEV companies in China, with leading software and hardware technology at our core and bringing innovation in advanced driver assistance, smart connectivity and core vehicle systems. We develop full-stack advanced driver assistance systems, or ADAS, software in house and have deployed such software on mass-produced vehicles. We started to roll out our XNGP in March 2023 and have made XNGP available in cities without HD map coverage since November 2023. As a result, its geographical coverage has expanded swiftly in China. Our Smart EVs and NEVs are designed to appeal to the large growing base of middle-class consumers globally. We primarily target the mid- to high-end segment in the global passenger vehicle market. Consumers choose our products primarily because of attractive design, industry-leading electrification and smart technologies, interactive smart mobility experience and long driving range. Since December 2018, we have launched and continuously upgraded a series of strategically positioned vehicle models. We are building a rapidly expanding, diversified portfolio of attractive Smart EV and NEV models to capture the growing demand for Smart EVs and NEVs and appeal to the differentiated needs of a broad customer base. • In March 2025, we upgraded the G6 and the G9 to their respective 2025 Edition and started delivery during the same month. • In April 2025, we upgraded the X9 to its latest 2025 Edition. • In July 2025, we launched the G7 and started delivery during the same month. • In August 2025, we launched the Next P7 and started delivery during the same month. • In November 2025, we launched the X9 EREV

credit_strengths.text: Revenue more than doubled over the two prior fiscal years, lifting operating losses sharply toward breakeven and moving the operating margin close to positive territory, a trajectory that materially outpaces the sector median margin and signals improving scale economics in the smart EV franchise.

Operating cash flow swung to a strong inflow after a prior-year outflow, comfortably funding capital expenditure and producing positive free cash flow, while unrestricted cash exceeds total borrowings and leaves the balance sheet in a net cash position.

key_risks.text: The borrowings note shows current borrowings concentrated in short-term bank loans and the current portion of long-term bank loans, so a large share of total debt matures within a year; refinancing depends on PRC bank appetite and could pressure liquidity if credit conditions tighten.

The MD&A risk discussion flags execution and market risks around the smart EV rollout, including new model launches and international expansion; these require continued heavy spending, and any demand shortfall would widen losses and consume the cash buffer that currently supports the net cash position.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income remains negative, so interest coverage is negative and well below the sector median; debt service currently relies on cash generation and the liquidity buffer rather than on earnings, and a conventional leverage ratio is not meaningful given negative EBITDA.

Free cash flow covers a meaningful portion of total borrowings and the current ratio sits modestly above one, but the current ratio is below the sector median, so near-term obligations are covered with limited headroom and depend on continued operating cash generation.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer is a growing smart EV manufacturer with a net cash balance sheet, improving operating cash flow and narrowing losses; leverage metrics are not meaningful because EBITDA is negative, so the credit view rests on liquidity and the cash burn trajectory rather than on coverage ratios.

Analyst judgement: continued revenue growth and cost discipline should move the company toward breakeven, but the short-dated debt structure and heavy investment needs keep refinancing and execution risk elevated; the indicative financial risk profile is not a rating and should be monitored against liquidity runway.

credit_strengths.text: 收益於之前兩個財政年度增加超過一倍，帶動經營虧損大幅收窄至接近收支平衡，並使經營利潤率接近正值，此走勢明顯超越行業中位數利潤率，反映智能電動車業務的規模經濟效益正在改善。
經營現金流由去年淨流出轉為強勁淨流入，足以應付資本開支並產生正自由現金流，而未受限現金超過借款總額，令資產負債表處於淨現金狀況。

key_risks.text: 借款附註顯示流動借款集中於短期銀行貸款及長期銀行貸款的即期部分，因此總債務中有很大比例於一年內到期；再融資取決於內地銀行的意願，若信貸環境收緊，可能對流動性構成壓力。
管理層討論與分析中的風險討論指出智能電動車推出相關的執行及市場風險，包括新車型發布及國際擴張；該等項目需要持續大量支出，若需求不足，將擴大虧損並消耗目前支撐淨現金狀況的現金緩衝。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營收入仍為負數，因此利息覆蓋率為負數，且遠低於行業中位數；債務償付目前依賴現金產生及流動性緩衝，而非依賴盈利，且由於EBITDA為負數，傳統槓桿比率並不具意義。
自由現金流覆蓋總借款中一個有意義的部分，而流動比率略高於一，但流動比率低於行業中位數，因此短期債務的覆蓋空間有限，並取決於持續的經營現金產生。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人為一家持續增長的智能電動車製造商，擁有淨現金資產負債表、經營現金流改善及虧損收窄；由於EBITDA為負數，槓桿指標並不具意義，因此信貸觀點取決於流動性及現金消耗走勢，而非覆蓋比率。
分析師判斷：持續的收入增長及成本控制應可推動公司邁向收支平衡，但短期債務結構及龐大投資需求令再融資及執行風險維持高企；指示性財務風險狀況並非評級，並應對照流動性跑道持續監察。
